title: 第0003章雾隐问道百年守护者的考验第0004章黑影噬心黑猫破局

凰溪岛的清晨带着海雾的湿冷，贾黑米背着简单的行囊，行走在前往凰溪山的公路上。
公路两旁，一边是鳞次栉比的度假区建筑，灵气充裕，武者往来不绝；另一边则是荒芜的废土边缘，土地龟裂，杂草丛生，空气中弥漫着淡淡的异兽腥气。这条公路是连接贫民区与凰溪山的唯一通道，也是都市与废土的分界线，平日里鲜有人迹，只有偶尔过往的运输车队和修炼者。
贾黑米将气血稳定在1.0卡巅峰，全身肌肉紧绷，精神高度集中。经过昨夜的修炼和诡异事件，他深刻明白这个世界的危险，尤其是在这种三不管的地带，随时可能遭遇异兽袭击或不法分子的抢劫。
他的全息手表上，显示着简易的地图，雾隐谷位于凰溪山深处，距离贫民区大约有三十公里的路程。以他现在初级武者的实力，步行需要四个小时左右。
走了大约一个小时，公路逐渐深入废土边缘，周围的建筑越来越少，取而代之的是废弃的车辆和残破的防御工事。空气中的异兽腥气越来越浓郁，远处的山林中，不时传来几声凄厉的兽吼，让人不寒而栗。
贾黑米加快了脚步，同时运转灵气，将“心灵破障”天赋开到最大。他能清晰地感知到周围空气中游离的灵气粒子，更能隐约察觉到隐藏在暗处的危险气息。
突然，他停下脚步，眼神锐利地看向公路右侧的一片废弃工厂。
“出来吧，跟着我这么久了，不累吗？”
他的声音不大，却在寂静的公路上清晰地回荡。
几秒钟后，一阵脚步声响起，五个穿着黑色武道服的少年从废弃工厂里走了出来，挡在了贾黑米的面前。
为首的少年染着黄毛，正是昨天在武道测试场上嘲笑贾黑米的武道馆馆主儿子——赵磊。他的气血值2.1卡，在同龄人中算是中等水平，身后的四个跟班，气血值也都在1.5卡以上。
“贾黑米，没想到你还真敢去雾隐谷啊？”赵磊双手抱胸，嘴角挂着戏谑的笑容，“一个刚突破1.0卡的废柴，也敢跟着神秘老头修炼？我看你是找死！”
贾黑米皱起眉头，心中了然。赵磊一直以来都以凰溪岛年轻一代的佼佼者自居，昨天看到叶利西收他为徒，肯定是嫉妒心作祟，所以带人来拦截他。
“让开。”贾黑米语气冰冷，没有多余的废话。
“让开？”赵磊嗤笑一声，“贾黑米，你以为你突破1.0卡就很了不起了？告诉你，在我眼里，你依然是那个任人欺凌的废柴！今天，我就让你知道，什么叫做差距！”
他身后的一个跟班上前一步，狞笑道：“赵少，跟他废话干什么？直接废了他，让他知道得罪赵少的下场！”
说完，那个跟班猛地冲向贾黑米，拳头带着呼啸的风声，朝着他的胸口砸来。他的气血值1.6卡，比贾黑米高出0.6卡，自信能一拳将贾黑米打倒。
贾黑米眼神一凝，没有丝毫畏惧。他深吸一口气，体内的灵气快速运转，按照基础拳的招式，一拳迎了上去。
“砰！”

两拳相撞，发出一声沉闷的巨响。
出乎所有人意料的是，贾黑米竟然纹丝不动，而那个跟班则惨叫一声，手臂弯曲成一个诡异的角度，整个人倒飞出去，重重地摔在地上，口中喷出一口鲜血。
“什么？！”
赵磊和其他三个跟班都惊呆了，难以置信地看着贾黑米。他们怎么也没想到，一个刚突破1.0卡的初级武者，竟然能一拳击败1.6卡的武者！
贾黑米自己也有些意外，他没想到，打通经脉后，再加上“心灵破障”天赋对灵气的精准操控，他的战斗力竟然提升了这么多。刚才那一拳，他不仅调动了全身的气血，还借助了周围的灵气粒子，让拳力远超自身的气血等级。
“你……你耍了什么花招？”赵磊脸色一变，语气中带着一丝忌惮。
“实力，就是最好的花招。”贾黑米眼神冰冷地看着他，“现在，你还要拦我吗？”
赵磊心中犹豫了。贾黑米的表现太过诡异，1.0卡的气血，却能发挥出远超这个等级的战斗力，他心里有些发怵。但他身后还有三个跟班，而且他的气血值比贾黑米高出1.1卡，若是就此退缩，以后在凰溪岛就没脸见人了。
“上！一起上！他只有一个人，我就不信我们五个还打不过他一个！”赵磊咬了咬牙，下令道。
说完，他率先冲向贾黑米，身后的三个跟班也紧随其后，四人从不同的方向攻来，拳风呼啸，灵气波动交织在一起，形成了一股不小的压迫感。
贾黑米丝毫不乱，“心灵破障”天赋让他能清晰地感知到四人的攻击轨迹和灵气流动。他脚步一错，灵活地避开了赵磊的拳头，同时一拳砸向旁边的一个跟班。
“砰！”
又是一声闷响，那个跟班同样被一拳击飞，失去了战斗力。
紧接着，贾黑米如同虎入羊群，在四人中间穿梭自如。他的基础拳招式虽然简单，但每一拳都精准地打在对方的破绽处，而且拳力十足，往往一拳就能让对方失去战斗能力。
赵磊越打越心惊，他发现贾黑米的速度和反应都远超他的想象，自己的攻击每次都被他轻松避开，而他的攻击却招招致命。更让他诡异的是，他感觉自己的灵气运转越来越滞涩，仿佛被什么东西干扰了一样。

The early morning on Huangxi Island was cold and humid with sea fog. Jia Heimi was walking on the road to Huangxi Mountain with a simple luggage on his back.
On both sides of the road, one side is lined with rows of resort buildings, full of spiritual energy, and warriors are constantly coming and going; the other side is the edge of the barren wasteland, with cracked land, overgrown weeds, and a faint smell of alien beasts filling the air. This road is the only passage connecting the slums and Huangxi Mountain, and it is also the dividing line between the city and the wasteland. It is rarely visited on weekdays, with only the occasional transport convoy and cultivators passing by.
Jia Heimi stabilized his energy and blood at the peak of 1.0 calories, his muscles all over his body were tense, and he was highly concentrated. After last night's practice and strange events, he deeply understood the dangers of this world, especially in such an unattended area, where he might be attacked by alien beasts or robbed by criminals at any time.
A simple map was displayed on his holographic watch. The Hidden Mist Valley was located deep in Huangxi Mountain, about thirty kilometers away from the slums. With his current strength as a junior warrior, it would take about four hours to walk.
After walking for about an hour, the road gradually deepened into the edge of the wasteland. There were fewer and fewer buildings around, replaced by abandoned vehicles and dilapidated fortifications. The smell of strange beasts in the air became stronger and stronger, and from the distant mountains and forests, several shrill beast roars could be heard from time to time, making people shudder.
Jiahemi quickened his pace and at the same time circulated his spiritual energy, maximizing his "psychic barrier breaking" talent. He could clearly sense the floating aura particles in the surrounding air, and could even vaguely detect the dangerous aura hidden in the dark.
Suddenly, he stopped and looked sharply at an abandoned factory on the right side of the road.
"Come out, you've been following me for so long, aren't you tired?"
His voice was not loud, but it echoed clearly on the silent highway.
A few seconds later, there was a sound of footsteps, and five teenagers wearing black martial arts uniforms walked out of the abandoned factory and stood in front of Jia Heimi.
The leading boy, with yellow hair, is Zhao Lei, the son of the martial arts gym owner who laughed at Jia Heimi at the martial arts test field yesterday. His qi and blood value is 2.1 calories, which is considered average among his peers. The four followers behind him also have qi and blood values ​​of above 1.5 calories.
"Jia Heimi, I didn't expect you to dare to go to the Hidden Mist Valley?" Zhao Lei crossed his arms with a joking smile on his lips, "A loser who just broke through the 1.0 card level dares to practice with the mysterious old man? I think you are looking for death!"
Jia Heimi frowned, understanding in his heart. Zhao Lei has always regarded himself as the leader of the younger generation on Huangxi Island. Yesterday, when he saw Ye Lixi accepting him as his disciple, he must have been jealous, so he brought someone to intercept him.
"Get out of the way." Jia Heimi's tone was cold, without unnecessary nonsense.
"Get out of the way?" Zhao Lei sneered, "Jia Heimi, do you think it's great that you broke through 1.0 card? Let me tell you, in my eyes, you are still the loser who allows others to bully you! Today, I will let you know what the gap is!"
A follower behind him stepped forward and said with a ferocious smile: "Master Zhao, why are you talking nonsense to him? Just kill him and let him know the consequences of offending Master Zhao!"
After saying that, the follower rushed towards Jiahemi, and with the sound of howling wind, his fist hit his chest. His blood value is 1.6 calories, 0.6 calories higher than Jiahemi's, and he is confident that he can knock Jiahemi down with one punch.
Jia Heimi's eyes were focused, without any fear. He took a deep breath, the spiritual energy in his body circulated rapidly, and punched forward according to the basic punching moves.
"Bang!"
The two fists collided, making a dull loud noise.
To everyone's surprise, Jiahemi remained motionless, while the follower screamed, bent his arms at a weird angle, flew backwards, and fell heavily to the ground, with a mouthful of blood spurting out of his mouth.
"What?!"
Zhao Lei and the other three followers were stunned and couldn't believe it.Looked at Jiahemi with faith. They never expected that a junior warrior who had just broken through 1.0 card could defeat a warrior with 1.6 card with one punch!
Jiahemi himself was a little surprised. He didn't expect that after opening up his meridians, coupled with the precise control of spiritual energy with the "Psychic Barrier Breaking" talent, his combat effectiveness would increase so much. With that punch just now, he not only mobilized the energy and blood in his body, but also used the surrounding spiritual energy particles to make the punch far more powerful than his own energy and blood level.
"You...what tricks did you play?" Zhao Lei's expression changed, with a hint of fear in his tone.
"Strength is the best trick." Jia Heimi looked at him with cold eyes, "Now, do you still want to stop me?"
Zhao Lei hesitated. Jia Heimi's performance was too weird. With 1.0 calories of blood, he was able to exert combat power far beyond this level. He felt a little frightened. But there are three followers behind him, and his health value is 1.1 calories higher than Jia Heimi. If he just backs down, he will be embarrassed to see people on Huangxi Island in the future.
"Go! Come together! He is alone, and I don't believe that the five of us can't defeat him!" Zhao Lei gritted his teeth and ordered.
After saying that, he took the lead and rushed towards Jia Heimi, followed closely by the three followers behind him. The four of them attacked from different directions, with the wind of fists roaring and the fluctuations of spiritual energy intertwined, creating a considerable sense of oppression.
Jia Heimi was not confused at all. His "Psychic Barrier Breaking" talent allowed him to clearly perceive the attack trajectories and spiritual energy flow of the four people. He made a wrong step and nimbly avoided Zhao Lei's fist, and at the same time punched a follower next to him.
"Bang!"
There was another muffled sound, and the follower was also punched away and lost his fighting ability.
Immediately afterwards, Jiahemi moved freely among the four people like a tiger among sheep. Although his basic punching moves are simple, each punch hits the opponent's weak point accurately, and the punch is very powerful. He can often make the opponent lose the ability to fight with one punch.
The more Zhao Lei fought, the more frightened he became. He discovered that Jia Heimi's speed and reaction were far beyond his imagination. He easily avoided his attacks every time, but his attacks were fatal. What made him even more weird was that he felt that his spiritual energy was becoming increasingly stagnant, as if something had interfered with it.
